svg.title: Reveal or copy one password
svg.desc: A protected desktop read uses the current login. Table-locked actions prompt for the Master Password and always relock in finally before delivering a result. Lifecycle changes discard stale results. Clipboard writes recheck authorization and attempt owned-value cleanup after 30 seconds and on lock.

g.text: Read arrows in order. SECRET = plaintext; KEY = encryption key; cylinders = stored data.
